title: Onboard horizon-13b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Menon
release_notes:
- Add support for horizon-13b v1.0 to model registry with metadata and performance profiles.
- Include automated changelog entry generation for new model onboarding.
- Add docs and tests for onboarding workflow (no breaking changes).
description: This PR onboards horizon-13b v1.0 into the model registry. Motivation: horizon-13b is a smaller, optimized transformer we want to expose to customers as a curated, Redwood-verified model with performance profiles and automated changelog entries. Changes include: 1) model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, weights provenance, expected tokenization quirks), 2) performance profiles (latency/throughput targets across canonical sequence lengths and hardware targets), 3) integration with the changelog automation so new model entries surface automatically in release notes and in the Console model catalog. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata YAML and standardized fields (license, source_hash, quantization_compat) - [x] Add perf profile JSON with sample measurements and SLO buckets - [x] Wire up changelog automation rules and template insertion - [x] Add minimal onboarding unit tests and CI workflow - [x] Update registry docs with model-specific notes Implementation notes: metadata.yaml follows the existing registry schema (fields: id, display_name, families, tokenizer, tokenizer_notes, license, weights_url, provenance, recommended_quant, tags). Perf profiles target sequence lengths 32/128/512 and list median p50/p90 per-token latency on T4/RTX6000/A100, plus recommended batch sizes and KV-cache warmup guidance. Changelog automation hook updates scripts/automation/update_changelog.py to pick up new metadata entries and append a structured release note under "Model Registry" for the next release. Linear ENG-2387 tracks validation load testing and perf-signoff tasks. CI: small unit test initially failed due to a missing test vector (fixed), full pipeline now passes. No runtime code changes to serving runtime in this PR — purely registry, docs, and automation.
commits: feat: automation/update_changelog.py: detect new models and render template
test: add model_onboarding_test.py covering metadata parsing and perf schema
review_comments: Aisha Patel: Left a few nits on metadata field naming (recommend 'weights_url' -> 'weights_uri' for consistency). Also asked for a short tokenizer_note explaining byte-level tokenization edge-case.

Priya Menon: Responded and updated metadata.yaml to use 'weights_uri' alias while keeping backward-compatible 'weights_url' key in ingestion. Added tokenizer_note explaining sentinel tokens for horizon tokenizer.
Miguel Ortega: Requested clarification on perf numbers — asked for run artifacts and seed config. Also suggested adding p99 to the perf profile for SRE alerts.
Priya Menon: Uploaded perf run artifacts to the CI artifact store and added p99 numbers to perf_profiles.json. Added a note about confidence intervals and run seed config to docs/models/horizon.md.
Sven Richter: Approving review after test green — recommended squash-merge and sanity check on changelog template formatting.
CI Bot: model-registry unit tests failed on first run (missing test vector). Author pushed fix in second commit. Full pipeline passed on rerun.
Release Manager: Verified changelog entry renders correctly in staging; merged to main.
merge_commit: squash commit: Onboard horizon-13b-v1.0 with metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
notes_for_release: Model: horizon-13b v1.0 — onboarded with performance profiles for T4/RTX6000/A100 (seq len 32/128/512). Changelog automation will add a Model Registry entry for this model in the next release. See docs/models/horizon.md for usage notes and recommended quantization profiles.
additional_context: Reasonable perf results observed after two warmup runs; perf numbers are preliminary and will be validated by infra perf team (ENG-2387). This PR intentionally avoids changes to serving runtime to speed onboarding; follow-up PR will include optimized kernels if needed.
testing_instructions: Run pytest tests/model_onboarding_test.py and validate that scripts/automation/update_changelog.py renders a release note snippet when pointed at models/horizon/metadata.yaml. See ci/workflows/model-registry.yml for the CI flow used in this PR.
